reading: US actor RJ Mitte has died at the age of 34.
He played the son of Walter White in the drama series Breaking Bad.
He worked to help people with disabilities.
He created a foundation to support his community.
Police confirmed his death, but they do not know the cause yet.
One actor from the show shared a kind message about his friend.

vocabulary.definition: A person who performs in movies, plays, or television shows.
A television show that tells a story over many episodes.
Physical or mental conditions that can make some everyday tasks harder to do.
An organization created to give money and support to others.
A group of people living in the same place or sharing a common interest.
